summary: Iteration 9 — Backend regression PASSED (23/23). TypeScript migration regression PASSED (all 5 newly-converted pages + 3 other routes render with ZERO runtime page-errors). Map-driven search BACKEND works perfectly (/api/tools accepts lat/lng/radius_km and returns sorted by distance — 4/4 new tests pass). Map-driven search FRONTEND has a MAJOR UX bug: panning fires the debounced API call correctly with new lat/lng/radius_km, BUT the hint pill (data-testid='map-search-hint') and recenter button (data-testid='map-recenter-btn') NEVER appear after pan, because they are rendered INSIDE the same JSX branch as the map; when the new search center returns zero tools, the empty-state branch wins and unmounts both the map AND the hint, leaving the user no way to recenter back to their location except 'Clear filters'.

ui_bugs.issue: MapSearchHint is rendered ONLY inside `view === 'map'` and split-view branches (lines 393 & 423). When tools.length===0 after a pan, the `No tools found` empty-state branch wins (line 364) and the entire map + hint pill unmount. Result: the hint NEVER actually becomes visible to a user who pans into an empty area, AND the user has no way to recenter except 'Clear filters' (which wipes ALL filters).

Pan ALWAYS overwrites the user's explicit radius_km slider value with the viewport-derived radius. If user dragged the slider to 200 km, then pans the map, radius gets clamped back to ~50 km, narrowing their search unexpectedly. Recommend: only derive radius_km when user has not explicitly set one (e.g., when the URL has no radius_km param) OR keep the explicit slider value as the source of truth and use viewport solely for the initial fit.

Initial map zoom is 11 on a 1920px-wide pane → the viewport spans ~3000 km. A user's tiny 50-px drag jumps the center hundreds of km, instantly producing empty results. Recommend either (a) a higher default zoom (13-14) when only a few tools are loaded in a single city, or (b) keeping fitBounds tight when all tools are clustered.

integration_issues.flow: Map pan -> search recenter -> hint pill
integration_issues.issue: Pan correctly fires GET /api/tools?lat=...&lng=...&radius_km=... (debounced ~350ms, verified ~700ms total). However, the hint pill that should appear AFTER pan never becomes visible because (1) it's tucked inside the map-render branch which is short-circuited when tools.length===0 and (2) even with non-empty results the pill DOM element rendered '0' on `locator.count()` in the split view (needs investigation — likely also because the second debounced response cleared `searchCenter.source` back to 'user' somehow OR because the request that returned non-empty data raced ahead of the one that did).

critical_code_review_comments: Browse.tsx line 384-426: <MapSearchHint /> is conditionally rendered inside the 'view === map' and split branches; when tools.length===0 the empty-state branch wins and unmounts the hint. FIX: render the hint as a sibling of the conditional or move the empty-state into a side-panel within the split layout so the map stays mounted.

Browse.tsx handleMapMove (line 164-171): overwriting URL radius_km on every pan creates a feedback loop where the user-chosen radius can never persist after the first pan. Consider keeping the user's explicit slider value as source-of-truth.

MapView.tsx default zoom=11 is too zoomed-out for a wide viewport; combined with the 350ms debounce, even casual mouse-wheel scrolls or accidental drags reset the search to a faraway center. Consider zoom=13 or capping minZoom.

MoveListener fires on every moveend including programmatic setView() done by FitOnce — FitOnce sets `hasUserMovedRef=true` indirectly because movestart fires. Recommend guarding the moveend handler to skip programmatic moves (track in FitOnce via a flag, or check `e.originalEvent` before treating it as a user pan).

Browse.tsx line 196: `effectiveCenter` calculation good; but no debouncing on the tools fetch — a pan triggers two fetches (one when searchCenter updates, one when radiusKm updates from handleMapMove) because both setStates fire in the same render. Consider batching with useMemo or single setState update.
action_items: [HIGH] Fix MapSearchHint visibility: keep the map (and the hint pill) mounted regardless of whether the result list is empty. Either move the empty-state to be an overlay on top of the map, or render the hint as a sibling outside the tools.length conditional. Without this, the entire map-driven-search feature is unusable as soon as the user pans into a region with no tools — they cannot recover except by clicking 'Clear filters'.

[HIGH] Investigate why the hint pill ALSO doesn't render after a pan that keeps results non-empty (we saw 0 count on the locator). Likely the timing of setState batching means searchCenter.source flips to 'user' from the userLocation effect or something resets the state. Add a console.log inside MapSearchHint to confirm searchCenter values at render time.
[MEDIUM] Don't overwrite user's explicit radius_km slider value during pan. Either skip URL update if user has manually set radius, or remove the slider once pan-driven search is the dominant flow.
[LOW] Bump MapView default zoom from 11 to 13 (or cap minZoom) so panning is less coarse on wide viewports.
[LOW] Suppress programmatic moveend events fired by FitOnce so they don't bubble up and set searchCenter.source='map' unintentionally on first load.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend map-search API at GET /api/tools?lat=..&lng=..&radius_km=.. is solid. The frontend feature has a structural JSX issue: hint pill (data-testid='map-search-hint') is nested inside the view-mode conditional that gets unmounted on empty results. Repro: open /browse with geolocation granted (Toronto coords); switch to map view; drag the map any distance — observe that no hint pill appears (regardless of whether results are empty or not). The Playwright test I used: page.context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']); page.context.set_geolocation({latitude:43.65,longitude:-79.38}); click view-map; drag .leaflet-container. The pan DOES fire GET /api/tools with new lat/lng/radius_km confirmed via page.on('request'). To retest after fix, verify (1) hint appears within 1s of pan, (2) hint stays visible even when tools.length===0, (3) clicking map-recenter-btn resets search to user's geolocation and removes the hint.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the hint-pill bug is JSX structural: Browse.tsx renders MapSearchHint inside the `view === 'map'` (line 393) and split-view (line 423) branches of a `loading ? : tools.length===0 ? : view==='grid' ? : view==='map' ? : <splitView>` chain. When tools.length becomes 0 after a pan, the empty-state JSX (line 365) replaces the map entirely. Mitigation: lift MapSearchHint up so it renders as a sibling of the conditional (or move the empty-state rendering INSIDE the map's container, e.g., a centered overlay div on top of the leaflet map). Secondary issue: handleMapMove overwrites radius_km from the user's slider — should only derive viewport radius when the user hasn't set one.
